text: The blue cart was rattling. Ada said, “I want to repair the blue cart.” Niko told Ada, “I need to move the tomato tray.” Ada borrowed the spanner. She used the spanner to tighten the nut. The wheel was locked. Ada said, “I am wrong.” Niko put the tomato tray under the bench. She loosened the nut. She located the kite string inside the wheel. Niko held the wheel. She unwound the kite string. She fitted the wheel. The wheel spun smoothly. Ada and Niko put the tomato tray in the blue cart. She pushed the blue cart to the sheltered corner. Ada returned the spanner to the bench. The tomato tray was sheltered. The wheel was quiet.
